items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Then I went to Pajot, my poor friend, who's always there. And I told Pajot about it and I got him interested.

ctx.x: I heard about it. You organized the group for the Creole Festival? I organized the group for the quadrille. Now I'm going to tell you how that happened.

I wasn't acquainted with Miss Senegal. But I heard of what her intention was to portray the amusement of the 90s. What made up the general pleasure of those times. And she wanted everything that could have happened at that time. So she was in the waltz for her quadrille. She didn't know where to find a quadrille. She knew to dance the quadrille and so it was a favorite dance at the time. And she wanted a quadrille of the old areas of that time. But at that time, my sister, she's passed away too. She passed away…
I missed that. I wasn't in town then. I saw some of those Creole festivals. Once went Piku and Celestan different people played. But about three years.
